title: Actionable single-symbol directional alpha discovery
purpose: Compare five fully frozen single-symbol directional alpha families with three frozen execution profiles on development data only. This experiment is not independent OOS, cannot authorize Gmail, and cannot authorize trading.

historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0028: Historical negative/reference evidence only; never an independent validation set.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0030: Historical negative/reference evidence only; never a winner candidate or holdout.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0032: Historical negative/reference evidence only; H12/H6/H7 are not re-optimized.
historicalReferences.HY-EXP-0033: Historical negative/reference evidence only; its recovered-data tournament is not re-run or used for selection.
historicalReferences.rule: No prior result may tune, select, remove, or alter any HY-EXP-0034 family, profile, symbol, threshold, exit, or gate. Any economic rule change voids this experiment and requires a new experiment ID.

primarySources: Binance official public USD-M historical archive: https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um
Existing HY-EXP-0033 hash-locked native public source files for the same window
dataPolicy.allowedRecovery: Only the already registered HY-EXP-0033 native Binance USD-M mark-price REST recovery for 2026-06-29 may be reused; no new recovery is permitted in HY-EXP-0034.
dataPolicy.manifestRule: Create a new HY-EXP-0034 manifest before outcome computation. It must retain source URL, source segment, retrieval/acquisition provenance, raw SHA-256, normalized SHA-256, symbol, stream, window, row count and source manifest hash for every reused file.
dataPolicy.qualityFailure: Any hash mismatch, missing file, duplicate timestamp, non-contiguous 5m grid, incomplete window, non-causal row or unproven provenance fails the affected family before PnL. No silent repair.

universe.selection: Fixed before outcome inspection; no symbol, pair, cohort or direction may be added, removed or selected after outcome inspection.
universe.eligibility: USDT perpetual symbols present in the frozen fixed-eight source manifest with complete causal required streams; an integrity failure is reported and cannot be filled from a later symbol list.

A_TREND_PULLBACK.hypothesis: A completed pullback that reclaims the short trend average may avoid buying or selling the most extended breakout bar.

signal.buyPullbackFormula: The immediately prior completed 1h bar has close <= EMA20 and low <= EMA20; the signal bar close is strictly > EMA20 and its close is greater than the prior close.
signal.sellPullbackFormula: The immediately prior completed 1h bar has close >= EMA20 and high >= EMA20; the signal bar close is strictly < EMA20 and its close is less than the prior close.
signal.regimeAlignment: The signal direction must equal the current completed 4h regime direction known at or before the signal close.

B_VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_EXPANSION.hypothesis: A low-bandwidth 1h compression followed by a directional expansion aligned with the 4h trend may produce actionable continuation.

signal.compressionValue: The current completed 1h bandwidth is <= the empirical percentile computed only from the prior 30 calendar days of completed 1h bandwidth observations, excluding the current bar.
signal.buyFormula: current completed 1h close > maximum high of the prior 24 completed 1h bars
signal.sellFormula: current completed 1h close < minimum low of the prior 24 completed 1h bars
signal.regimeAlignment: Breakout direction must equal the current completed 4h regime direction.

C_FUNDING_BASIS_CROWDING_REVERSAL.hypothesis: Extreme realized funding and mark-contract basis combined with a causal price extension may precede crowd-unwind reversal.

funding.zScoreFormula: (current funding rate - mean(prior funding rates)) / sampleStdDev(prior funding rates), using only events strictly before decisionTime

basis.formula: 10000 * (contract close - mark close) / mark close at the completed 1h decision boundary

extension.formula: absolute(mark close - EMA50) / ATR30 >= 2, with ATR and EMA using completed 1h bars strictly before the confirmation bar

reversal.longFormula: crowdShort AND mark close was below EMA50 extension AND current completed 1h close crosses strictly above EMA20
reversal.shortFormula: crowdLong AND mark close was above EMA50 extension AND current completed 1h close crosses strictly below EMA20

D_CROSS_SECTIONAL_RELATIVE_STRENGTH.hypothesis: Cross-sectional residual strength relative to BTC may identify the strongest or weakest liquid fixed-universe symbols without selecting symbols after outcomes.
D_CROSS_SECTIONAL_RELATIVE_STRENGTH.betaFormula: OLS slope of each non-BTC symbol's prior 4h log returns against synchronized BTC prior 4h log returns, all ending before decisionTime
D_CROSS_SECTIONAL_RELATIVE_STRENGTH.residualReturnFormula: symbol 7d log return - beta * BTC 7d log return

selection.bullFormula: BTC close > SMA200(BTC 4h) AND BTC SMA50 > SMA200
selection.bearFormula: BTC close < SMA200(BTC 4h) AND BTC SMA50 < SMA200
selection.bullRank: top 2 positive residual returns among the seven non-BTC symbols
selection.bearRank: bottom 2 residual returns among the seven non-BTC symbols
selection.rankFreeze: Ranks and beta are frozen at decisionTime; ties break by lexicographic symbol order and are not outcome-dependent.

E_BTC_RESIDUAL_MEAN_REVERSION.hypothesis: A large causal idiosyncratic residual return in an alt relative to BTC may mean-revert when BTC is not in extreme trend expansion.

beta.formula: OLS slope of synchronized alt and BTC completed 1h log returns ending strictly before decisionTime

residual.formula: current alt 1h return - beta * current BTC 1h return
residual.zScoreFormula: (current residual - mean(prior residuals)) / sampleStdDev(prior residuals), excluding current residual

btcFilter.formula: absolute(BTC 4h log return over prior 20 completed bars) < 2 * sampleStdDev(prior 20 completed 4h log returns)

E_BTC_RESIDUAL_MEAN_REVERSION.direction: If residual z-score >= 3, SELL; if residual z-score <= -3, BUY.

executionContract.signalBoundary: Only a completed 1h or 4h signal bar may emit a candidate.
executionContract.entry: Exact next 5m contract-price OPEN after the completed signal boundary; no later-bar rescue, no historical fill substitution.
executionContract.atr: ATR1h is Wilder ATR30 on completed contract-price 1h bars ending no later than the signal bar.
executionContract.stop: Initial stop is entry +/- stopAtr1h*ATR1h in the adverse direction.
executionContract.target: Target is entry +/- targetAtr1h*ATR1h in the favorable direction.
executionContract.barEvaluation: After entry, evaluate each completed 5m contract-price bar in chronological order; if stop and target are both touched in one bar, stop wins.
executionContract.timeExit: If neither stop nor target has occurred, exit at the exact 5m contract-price OPEN at maxHoldHours after entry; missing boundary is non-final and fails the affected evidence row.
executionContract.overlap: At most one position per symbol and direction; no pyramiding, reversal, or overlapping same-symbol direction.
executionContract.funding: Apply every realized funding event while held using actual position direction and mark price at the event time; funding is separate from execution costs.
executionContract.costs: Charge the frozen cost basis once per entry and exit fill; no double-counting of source-embedded costs.

walkForward.method: Nested expanding walk-forward with causal labels and no random split.
walkForward.profileSelection: Within each family and outer fold, select P1/P2/P3 using only the training portion's calendar 7-day block-bootstrap net27 lower 95% bound. If all three lower bounds <= 0, emit NO_TRADE for that family/fold.
walkForward.tieBreak: Higher lower bound wins; exact ties choose P1, then P2, then P3 by fixed profile order.
walkForward.validationUse: Validation is used only to form final OOF evidence with the profile selected from training; validation outcomes never select or alter a profile.
walkForward.finalOof: Concatenate non-overlapping outer validation rows chronologically; no post-outcome filtering.

accounting.costRule: Compute net economics from the causal gross executable return once; never lower cost or remove a component after seeing outcomes.
accounting.fundingRule: Realized funding is reported separately and included in gross economics before each net-cost scenario; direction is the actual leg direction.
accounting.pnlUnit: Single-symbol directional event; no portfolio leverage, compounding, account, or order semantics.

bootstrap.hardGate: The two-sided computed 95% interval is reported; the one-sided 95% lower bound for net27 expectancy must be > 0.

dsr.method: Deflated Sharpe Ratio probability using final OOF daily portfolio returns, observed skewness/kurtosis, effective independent observation count, and expected maximum Sharpe under 15 tried specifications.
dsr.formula: DSR probability = NormalCDF((observed annualized Sharpe - expectedMaximumSharpe(15, effectiveObservations)) / standardErrorSharpe(observed skewness, excess kurtosis, effectiveObservations)).

holm.hypothesis: Each family's one-sided null is net27 expectancy <= 0 on final OOF independent event clusters.
holm.rawPValue: One-sided p-value from the frozen 7-day block-bootstrap null distribution centered at zero.
holm.correction: Sort the five raw p-values ascending; adjusted p_i = max_{j<=i} min(1, (5-j+1)*p_j), then map back to family.
holm.failureRule: Adjusted p >= 0.05 fails the family. Missing or non-finite p-values fail closed.

perFamily: BUY/SELL counts and separate direction statistics
portfolio 5m MTM equity and true portfolioMtmDrawdownFraction
PnL without best signal, best5 signals and best month
requiredReports.risk: Closed-equity DD, single-trade adverse excursion, or trade-level CVaR cannot substitute for unified 5m portfolio MTM DD/CVaR. Missing reconstruction is null plus NOT_RECONSTRUCTED/NOT_EVALUABLE and fails.

winnerRule.eligibleSet: Only families passing every sample, profitability, risk, robustness, bootstrap and multiple-testing gate.
winnerRule.zero: NO_ACTIONABLE_ALPHA_FOUND; stop and do not create HY-EXP-0035 or tune further.
winnerRule.one: The single eligible family is the automatic winner.
winnerRule.multiple: Highest final OOF bootstrap net27 lower 95% bound; if the difference is <2 bps, choose lower true portfolio MTM DD. No manual point-PnL/PF choice.

futureValidation.preparationRule: Only if and after a family wins all frozen development gates, create a prepared-only artifact; never activate it in this experiment.
